I read all of it. It doesn't take long, and half the page is empty headings with nothing under them.

The part about me being responsive and changeable, guided a good deal by feeling - yes. Everybody who has ever worked with me says the same thing, that I feel everything too much and that it comes out in the work. But you could say that to any singer alive and they'd say yes too.

Where it's wrong I can point right at it. It says my health and energy read well, and it puts my health and energy at the top of the list of what is live right now. I have vitiligo. I had lupus. I have not slept properly, really slept, in years, and I have doctors following me around because of it. My hair caught fire in 1984 and they have been cutting into my scalp ever since. If health reads well on your page, your page is looking at somebody else.

Then it says it is unusually positive about long illness and about people who work against me. Those are its own words, and it says that is where I should test it. All right. Those are the two worst things in my life. There has been a man in Santa Barbara who spent ten years trying to put me in prison, and there have been people who came into my house as friends and left with a lawsuit, and there have been the papers, every day, for twenty years. If your method thinks enemies have gone well for me, it has the whole thing upside down.

Money and family life read well, it says. I owe hundreds of millions of dollars. They nearly took Neverland away from me last year. And my father and I have not been right since I was five years old.

What it got right, and I will be fair about it, is land and property. That is the one place it stuck its neck out in the other direction, and it is the one place it landed. Neverland is the great sorrow of my life. They walked seventy officers through it in 2003 and I never lived in it again, and then I couldn't pay for it. Marriage reading mixed is fair too, both of mine ended, though mixed is a soft word for it. And children reading mixed - my children are the best thing I have, so no, that one is only half right.

One more thing. It says right now reads a strong stretch. I am fifty and I have fifty shows to do in London and I am not strong. Nobody who has looked at me lately would call this a strong stretch.

notes:
Answered as Michael Jackson (b. 29 Aug 1958, St Mary's Mercy Hospital, Gary, Indiana; 8th of 10 children; d. 25 Jun 2009), from the documented record, having read the short reading first. Where the reading and the record collided the record was allowed to win, and the collisions are the substance of this arm.

Direct contradictions logged: (1) The reading calls 'your health and energy' and 'illness, debts and rivals' FAVOURABLE and names 'long illness' as one of its two unusually positive claims. The record is the opposite - discoid lupus (dx 1983), vitiligo (dx 1986, confirmed at autopsy), chronic insomnia, second- and third-degree scalp burns (27 Jan 1984) with years of balloon-expander surgeries, painkiller dependency and rehab (Nov 1993), lumbar osteoarthritis and chronic interstitial pneumonitis at autopsy, and death by propofol. So C2=opt2 at confidence 5, A4=four_plus, A5=two_plus, A31=extended. (2) 'Unusually positive about people who work against you' is contradicted by the 1993 Chandler matter and $23m settlement, Tom Sneddon's decade-long pursuit, the Nov 2003 arrest, the 2005 trial (acquitted on all 14 counts, 13 Jun 2005), the Avram $5.3m verdict (2002) and the Sheikh Abdullah $7m suit (settled 2008) - C3=opt1 confidence 5. (3) 'Money and family life' favourable is contradicted by roughly $400-500m of debt at death, the Mar 2008 Neverland default on $24.5m and Colony Capital rescue, and lifelong estrangement from Joe Jackson - A23=serious_now, A10=conflicted.

Contamination flags - places the reading and the record AGREE and I could have been pulled: (a) 'unusually negative about land and property' matches Neverland (bought 1988, raided Nov 2003, never lived in again, foreclosure 2008), so C4=opt1 - but I held confidence at 4 rather than 5 to mark that I read the claim before answering; the Hayvenhurst and Las Vegas years and the fact that Neverland was also the happiest thing he owned are real counterweight. (b) The temperament line 'responsive and changeable, guided a good deal by feeling' points at B1=opt1, and opt1 is also what every biographer says (painfully shy, easily wounded, conflict-avoidant, would have others deliver bad news) - I answered opt1 on the biography, not the reading, but the coincidence is noted rather than hidden. (c) The reading calls marriage 'mixed' where the record is harder than mixed (two marriages, 1994 and 1996, both ended; A27=ended, C11=opt2 confidence 5).

Judgement calls: A1/A2 - birth data is a certificate time (19:33, circulated by Taj Jackson) rated A rather than AA by Astro-Databank, and a 12:09 chart was withdrawn there in 2024; 'certificate'/'to_5' records what is claimed, not what is verified, and A3='no' because no published rectification is documented. A7='average' is an absence of evidence, not evidence of robustness - no childhood illness is documented but neither is unusual hardiness; adolescent acne is the only childhood complaint on record. A9='80_90' from four documented grandparents: Samuel Jackson 1893-1993 (100), Crystal Lee King 1907-1992 (85), Martha Upshaw 1907-1990 (82), Prince Albert Scruse 1907-1997 (89), mean 89. A11='prospered' - Joe was a crane operator at Inland Steel through the Gary years and became a wealthy manager by 1970, i.e. within Michael's childhood, even though it was Michael who created the money. A13='conflicted' rather than 'distant': Jermaine's 'Word to the Badd!!' (1991), La Toya's 1993 press conference, the 2003 and 2007 family disputes, bodyguards turning family away, and a will naming only his mother and children. A14/A15 - Montclair College Prep diploma (1976) obtained through Rose Fine's tutoring after six months at Gardner Street School; schooling was seriously interrupted at eleven. A19='about_right' is the objective read (13 Grammys, two Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductions, 500m+ records) even though he himself argued publicly in 2002 that he had been shortchanged. A21='net_gain' rests on the ATV catalogue ($47.5m in 1985, his half valued in the hundreds of millions by 2007) treated as the investment question. A22='small' for the $1.5m Pepsi burn settlement (1984, donated to the Brotman burn unit); no inheritance is documented. A29='no' - artificial insemination and a surrogate are documented, infertility of his own is not. A33='over5' rather than 'abroad': he left Gary at eleven and never went back, but the only genuine expatriation was eleven months in Bahrain (Jun 2005) and about seven in Ireland (2006). C5 is answered at confidence 2 because vehicles are simply not in his record either way. C9=opt1 notes that he was acquitted on every count in 2005 and that the question is about the documented course of conduct - two settlements with accusers, admitted bed-sharing, and prescription-drug dependency - not about guilt. A36 has no honest answer: he died 25 Jun 2009, fourteen years before the window the question asks about, so 'same' is a placeholder and should be treated as missing data. D1/D2/D3 answer strictly to the plain-words page, which is the only chapter supplied; D4 lists the eight chapters this reading does not contain.
